import random

import string

import time



from selenium import webdriver

from selenium.webdriver.common.by import By

from selenium.webdriver.support.ui import WebDriverWait

from selenium.webdriver.support import expected_conditions as EC





def generate_random_string(length):

    characters = string.ascii_letters + string.digits

    random_string = ''.join(random.choices(characters, k=length))

    return random_string





def login(username: str, password: str):

    options = webdriver.ChromeOptions()

    options.add_argument("--no-sandbox")

    options.accept_insecure_certs = True

    base_url = "https://arcadia.example.com"

    driver = webdriver.Chrome(options=options)

    driver.request_interceptor = lambda request: setattr(request.headers, 'X-Bot-Name', 'MyAwesomeJusBot')

    driver.get(base_url + "/trading/login.php")

    wait = WebDriverWait(driver, 10)

    username_field = wait.until(

        EC.presence_of_element_located((By.NAME, "username"))

    )

    username_field.send_keys(username)

    password_field = driver.find_element(By.NAME, "password")

    password_field.send_keys(password)

    login_button = driver.find_element(By.CSS_SELECTOR, "button.btn-primary")

    login_button.click()

    time.sleep(1)





if __name__ == "__main__":

    for iteration in range(100):

        user = generate_random_string(8)

        generated_password = generate_random_string(8)

        login(user, generated_password)
